description: This file contains a SQL script for creating a user-defined function (UDF) called 'UDFStripHTMLTags' that strips HTML tags from a string within a MySQL database. It includes setup commands, such as setting the delimiter, and the function implementation.

methods.name: UDFStripHTMLTags
methods.description: A user-defined function that takes a string 'Dirty' and removes all HTML tags by iteratively locating and removing substrings enclosed in '<' and '>'.
